ops.title: worktree pruning stranded in-flight parser+cmd lanes; branches survive
ops.body: 2026-07-20: the missing-primitives wave's /tmp worktrees (cct-arity-v2 @ arity-unwrap-v2, capt-hook-cmd @ cmd-api) were cleaned off disk (git worktree 'prunable') out from under two running agents, so their fix/reconcile rounds committed NOTHING. Recovery: branch refs survived in the object store — recreate worktrees from them (git worktree add <path> <branch>), don't respawn onto dead dirs. Ground truth at that moment: framework promotions (globbing + 5 conditions) ALREADY on captain-hook origin/main; pin already >=14.6.1 (other session's v14.6 migration); cc-transcript arity+split_options UNRELEASED (only on arity-unwrap-v2 @ bfd05b4, +6 security-review holes); cmd.py UNLANDED (only on cmd-api @ 7df3fc42, unreconciled to v14.6). Lesson: verify disk/branch ground truth before trusting a long teammate-message narrative — worktree lifetime is not guaranteed across a multi-session wave.
